description: Search symbols by name, kind, or text. Use instead of Grep for functions, classes, methods, variables. For raw text/comment search use search_text; for references to a known symbol use find_usages. Read-only. Returns JSON: { items: [{ symbol_id, name, kind, fqn, signature, file, line, score }], total, search_mode } — mode-specific shape when mode!=single. Supports `output_format: "toon"`.

decorator.description: Filter to symbols carrying this decorator/annotation/attribute

detail_level.description: Output verbosity. "minimal" saves ~40-60% tokens (drops scores, fqn, signatures, summaries). Use to pick a candidate before get_symbol. Default: "default".

drill_from.description: [mode="drill"] File path or symbol_id to restrict results to.

extends.description: Filter to classes/interfaces extending this name

fusion.description: Enable Signal Fusion — WRR ranking across lexical, structural, similarity, and identity channels. Weights come from `tune_weights`.

fuzzy.description: Typo-tolerant search. Auto-enabled when exact search returns 0 results.

implements.description: Filter to classes implementing this interface

kind.description: Filter by symbol kind (class, method, function, etc.)

mode.description: single (default): top-K. tiered: high/medium/low buckets. drill: scoped to drill_from. flat: raw FTS. get: exact lookup. Omit to auto-pick.

output_format.description: "json" (default) or "toon" (lossless, 30-60% fewer tokens). "markdown" behaves as json here.

retriever.description: Run one named retrieval algorithm instead of the mode dispatcher. Ignores mode/filters/fuzzy/fusion.

semantic.description: auto (default): hybrid if AI available. on: force hybrid. off: lexical-only. only: pure vector. Non-"off" needs an AI provider.

name: search
